# Cancellation Policy

## Cancellation requests

Cancellation availability depends on the current order status.
Customers should check the cancellation option displayed in the application.

## Orders already being prepared

An order that is already being prepared may not be eligible for cancellation.
The customer should contact customer support if the cancellation option
is unavailable.

## Refunds

Refund eligibility and processing time depend on the circumstances
and the applicable order policy.
Customers should contact customer support for a decision about a specific order.

# Courier FAQ

## How can I track an order?

Customers can use the order tracking page to see the latest available status.

## Why is an order late?

Possible reasons include traffic, bad weather, restaurant preparation time,
and courier availability.

## What should I do if the order status does not change?

The customer should contact customer support and provide the order reference.

## Is the estimated delivery time guaranteed?

No. The estimated delivery time is a prediction and may change.

# Delivery Policy

## Standard delivery

Standard delivery is available for eligible orders.
The estimated delivery time depends on the delivery model's prediction
and may change because of traffic, weather, restaurant preparation,
and courier availability.

## Delivery delays

If an order is delayed, the customer should check the latest order status.
The estimated delivery time is an estimate, not a guaranteed arrival time.

## Order status

The customer should use the order tracking page to check the latest status.
If the status has not changed for an extended period, the customer should
contact customer support.

# Weather and Delivery Guidelines

## Rain

Rain may slow courier travel and increase delivery time.
Customers should use the latest order tracking information.

## Snow and ice

Snow and icy roads may create unsafe travel conditions.
Courier safety takes priority over delivery speed.

## Severe weather

During severe weather, deliveries may be delayed or temporarily unavailable.
Customers should check order status or contact customer support.
